jevzip-code-testset.tar.xz.description: Held-out Python test files: first 1 MiB of NetworkX 3.7 source and the pydoc_data package of CPython 3.12.13, with their licenses

jevzip-lanes-11m-code.pt.description: 11.14M-parameter lanes-order model (ctx 512, block 512, d_model 384, 6 layers, 6 heads) for Python source code
jevzip-lanes-11m-code.pt.trained_on: jevzip Python-source corpus: data/code/train.bin, 147.8 MB (python -m jevzip.data: site-packages + CPython 3.12 stdlib on the build machine, minus held-out mpmath, networkx, pydoc_data)

jevzip-lanes-11m-enwik8.pt.description: 11.14M-parameter lanes-order model (ctx 512, block 512, d_model 384, 6 layers, 6 heads) for English Wikipedia XML text; the default model
jevzip-lanes-11m-enwik8.pt.trained_on: enwik8, first 90,000,000 bytes (data/enwik8/train.bin; standard 90M/5M/5M LM split, val = next 5M, test = last 5M)
